name: Screen
summary: The frame of a phone screen: the safe area, the page padding, the background and, when asked, the scroll and the pull to refresh. Native only.

a11y.apg: No role of its own: the screen reader reads what is inside, in order. With onRefresh, the pull to refresh is the platform's own control.

props.name: edges
props.description: Which edges keep clear of the notch and the gesture bar.

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds the page padding. With scroll, it goes inside the scrolling area, so the scrollbar stays at the edge.

props.name: background
props.description: The colour behind the screen: the page, or one of the two surface steps.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Turns on the pull to refresh and is called when the person pulls.

props.name: refreshing
props.description: Shows the refresh spinner while the new data loads.

props.name: footer
props.description: What stays at the bottom, out of the scroll: an action bar.
